title: P2 SG-0 Passive R/C/L Physical Intake + Witness Packet
purpose: Convert the source-bound P2 resistor, capacitor and inductor candidate instances into one controlled first-article evidence path. Freeze actual material lots, machine/tool/calibration and as-built geometry before promoting any source/geometry inference to measured evidence.

execution_gate_cascade.pass: Exact supplier/product/lot-or-batch/source record captured for each material actually used; package/source identity conflicts resolved; material remains held if provenance is ambiguous.
Actual machine/tool/cure route and measurement instruments identified; calibration/readback valid at execution; relevant printable line/gap/thickness/registration envelope attributable.
Coupon CAD/config revision frozen; consequential dimensions measurable with datum and uncertainty; configuration hash generated.
Commanded and actual cure/process/environment history recorded without unresolved consequential excursion.
Calibrated raw R/C/L observations captured with environment/fixture/configuration and uncertainty; no source/inferred number relabelled MEASURED.
Raw-data hashes, calculation/model hashes, accept/reject/HOLD and DBR pointer bind the same exact instance revisions.

lot_passport_intake_schema.rule: Blank/unknown fields remain explicit UNKNOWN; do not invent lot, manufacture or expiry data.

machine_tool_calibration_schema.rule: Capability values remain UNKNOWN until source-bound or measured; component datasheets do not substitute for whole-machine capability.

shared.datum: one declared coupon datum/frame shared by R/C/L regions
shared.identity: persistent coupon object/revision marker tied to geometry/process/readback
shared.freeze_rule: Exact dimensions are frozen only after G0/G1 resolve actual materials and machine capability.

resistor.target_acceptance_intent: +/-20% of 1.0 kOhm after declared cure and dimensional/adhesion pass
resistor.topology: uniform or serpentine printed resistor with Kelvin/4-wire-compatible terminals

parameterization.geometry_rule: Choose W >= measured machine/process minimum with margin; then L=N_sq*W. Do not freeze numeric L/W before Rs_meas and machine envelope.

resistor.source_comparator: ECI 7004LR/NCI7002 family source record spans approximately 50–5000 ohm/sq/25 um by blend; comparator only, exact blend/process unselected.

capacitor.topology: parallel-plate first comparator; two attributable conductor electrodes separated by exact measured HN film

nominal_geometry_for_freeze_after_gates.guard_configuration: NONE_FIRST_ARTICLE / fixture blank and edge-fringe comparator retained

source_property_comparator.evidence: DuPont HN source property / typical comparator

capacitor.model: C=epsilon0*epsilon_r*A/d only as ideal parallel-plate comparator; measured C is primary. Fringe, electrode/process, fixture, loss, leakage, T/RH and actual thickness remain separate.

inductor.topology: machine-compatible air-core planar spiral/loop witness selected after G1; no core-dependent claim

parameterization.DCR_model: DCR ~= Rs_meas * conductor_path_length/trace_width plus measured contact contribution where applicable
parameterization.L_model: Use topology-valid established geometry approximation or EM field solve only after geometry freeze; retain parasitic capacitance and nearby-body boundary state.
parameterization.freeze_rule: Do not invent N,w,s,Dout or target L before machine envelope and intended measurement range are declared.

resistor.promotion: MEASURED only after exact lot/process/geometry/calibration/raw-data bindings and valid ohmic regime.

capacitor.promotion: Geometry/source inference remains ENGINEERING_INFERENCE; only calibrated electrical observation promotes C to MEASURED for the declared f/bias/T/RH/configuration.

inductor.promotion: MEASURED only over the declared frequency/configuration; no current/thermal/RF-power rating inferred.

process_sequence: resolve/freeze coupon datum and R/C/L geometry
hash geometry/config and bind source lots
deposit/form R/C/L regions in directional sequence that does not damage prior regions
perform WIT-002 capacitor measurement including 1 kHz comparator point
perform WIT-003 inductor DCR/L/Q sweep as instrumented
write raw/calculation hashes and DBR readback
only passed measured P2 outputs may feed P3 LC/RF derivation

p3_dependency.release_condition: Measured and accepted CGXI-P2-C-001 and CGXI-P2-L-001, plus attributable interconnect/fixture geometry and calibration.
p3_dependency.rule: f0=1/(2*pi*sqrt(L*C)) is a first comparator using measured P2 inputs; loss/parasitics/mutual coupling require actual 3D model and P3 network witness.

physical_authority.permitted_by_packet: digital preparation, lot/tool/calibration intake, geometry freeze, test-plan/readback schema
physical_authority.execution_requires: separate explicit applicable physical/safety authority after G0-G3 are satisfied
